android.desc:
Quitting smoking is possible for everyone – the key is willpower.

But especially in difficult moments, a little reminder can help you stay on track.

Purio helps you keep your personal motivation in focus.

The app shows you how much time has passed since you quit smoking, how much money you've already saved, and how much valuable time you've gained back.

If the urge does get stronger, Purio offers additional support:

Little games distract your hands and help you get through the moment, while guided breathing exercises give you renewed calm and energy.

Purio accompanies you on your journey – step by step, moment by moment.
